welcome.title: Welcome to ClaudeDeck
welcome.step1: Add a Claude account in Settings and sign in.
welcome.step2: Create a project, pick its folder and assign an account.
welcome.step3: Open a Claude tab in the project; it runs with the assigned account.

project.name: Name
project.noAccounts: Add at least one account before creating a project.
project.accountChangeNote: Account changes apply to newly opened sessions; running sessions keep the previous account.

session.confirmClose: This session is still running. Close it?
session.staleAccount: This session runs with the previous account. Restart it to use the new account.
session.notLoggedIn: Account "{{account}}" does not appear to be signed in.
session.noSessions: No sessions in this project. Open a new Claude or Terminal tab above.

settings.title: Settings
settings.removeFiles: Also sign out and delete the account's local files

errors.ACCOUNT_RUNNING: Sessions are still running with this account. Close them first.
